I changed `src/index.ts` so the value is the string `"8417"` instead of the number `8417`. That matches the declared type `string`. I assumed you wanted the string. If `label` should be a number, change the annotation to `number` instead.

I couldn't run `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit` to confirm the fix. TypeScript isn't installed here: there's no `node_modules` directory, and `package.json` has no dependencies. Once you've installed it, run that command to check.
